name: Tree ring dish
label: Dishes
lead: Dish styled as a cross-section of a tree trunk, with rings on the bottom and dark bark outside - for water or food in a forest or tropical terrarium.

description.html: This tree ring dish looks like a sawn-off piece of a trunk. The bottom is light, with clearly carved growth rings and cracks, and the outside is shaped like rough bark in black and beige tones. The inner edge is slightly raised, so the water stays in the dish even when your animal steps on the rim.

The wood look is a good choice for forest and tropical setups: terrariums with cork bark, branches, vines and leaves. There the dish looks like part of the environment rather than an add-on. It suits snakes such as the corn snake, as well as lizards that live on the forest floor.
Although it looks like wood, it is a cast imitation rather than a piece of real wood, so it will not rot like a real log in a humid terrarium.

Place the dish on a level surface on the cooler side of the terrarium. In a tropical terrarium the water in the dish also helps maintain humidity. Change the water every day and occasionally clean the rings on the bottom with a brush, since sediment collects in the grooves.
